description: Atoms builds physical automation aimed at transforming industry and moving the world.
Ayar Labs is aiming to transform AI scale-up infrastructure with co-packaged optics (CPO) built for high-volume manufacturing.
Atlas Motion makes motors and actuators for drones, robotics, and other defense platforms.
Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated minerals company focused on supplying the minerals critical to modern energy, AI, and defense technologies.
Mach Industries is a defense manufacturing company that develops and produces unmanned aerospace and defense systems, along with the infrastructure required to manufacture them at scale.

Jesse & Ben’s is a clean-label frozen French fry brand that makes restaurant-quality, seed-oil-free fries using just three simple ingredients: non-GMO potatoes, 100& grass-fed beef tallow or avocado oil, and real sea salt.
Hark is an AI company developing multimodal systems and hardware as a universal human-machine interface, focusing on proactive, personalized AI with speech, vision, and memory.

World Labs is a spatial intelligence startup. The company build Large World Models designed to perceive, generate, and reason about three-dimensional physical and virtual world from 2D images, text, and video.
Advanced Machine Intelligence (AMI) is a research lab developing world-model AI that learns structured representations of the physical world to enable reasoning, prediction, and action.
Recursive self-improving superintelligence to automate knowledge discovery.
Unconventional AI is rethinking the foundations of a computer to optimize energy efficiency for AI.
UMA provides warehouses and manufacturing industries with sustainable logistics, automation, and IoT solutions.
Biologica is a women’s health company creating stage-specific nutritional support for the reproductive years, perimenopause, and postmenopause.
Avalo is an AI-driven crop innovation company developing new seed varieties for complex, under innovated crops including cotton, sugarcane, rice, and rubber
Big Shot Pictures is a digital-first animation and family entertainment studio.
Yassir offers on-demand services, including ride-hailing, delivery, and payment solutions.
ConductorOne is an AI-native identity security platform that protects every identity: human, non-human, and AI.

Lead is a state-chartered bank building technology-first, compliant banking infrastructure for the world’s top fintechs. Its banking-as-a-service (BaaS) platform delivers programmable products designed for direct integration into transaction workflows—enabling fintechs, consumer, and digital asset companies to scale with compliance and creativity.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is aiming to change how military systems are designed, built and sold.
OpenEvidence is on a mission to organize and expand global medical knowledge.
Axiom’s mission is to build a self-improving superintelligent reasoner, starting with an AI mathematician

Torus is building America’s next generation of power infrastructure. Its hybrid inertial-battery systems provide the same stabilizing services as conventional power plants — without combustion or chemicals. Torus technology helps utilities, data centers, and industrial and commercial customers strengthen the grid, integrate renewables, and meet rising energy demand.
Applied Intuition is the vehicle intelligence company that accelerates the global adoption of safe, AI-driven machines.
Sequen delivers the first in-session Behavior Design Engine combining the advanced AI/ML techniques of Large Event Models (LEMs) and reinforcement learning.
Laminar is aiming to transform how food and beverage factories run by using its in-line sensors and turnkey AI solution to unlock lost production time.
Twelve is a carbon transformation company converting captured carbon dioxide into valuable chemicals, fuels, and other essential products.
Penguin AI is a healthcare AI company focused on transforming operations for healthcare payers and providers by leveraging cutting-edge generative AI technology.
Goop Kitchen is a clean-eating restaurant concept with a mission to accelerate the clean-food movement by proving that eating clean can be delicious, satisfying, and accessible.

Epic Games is an American video game and software company that creates games and offers its game engine technology to other developers. It specializes in developing games, engine technology and operates a game store that empowers others to make quality games and 3D content, thereby providing game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and virtual reality devices.
Hippocratic AI develops a safety-focused large language model for healthcare, safety, and accuracy.
Stability AI is a global company working to enhance humanity’s creativity through artificial intelligence. Stability AI develops a range of generative AI models for image, language, audio, and video.

Samsara Eco is a company that uses enzymes to recycle plastic waste into new plastics. Their technology breaks down plastic into its molecular building blocks, which can then be re-synthesized into virgin quality plastic.

Sybill is an AI assistant that blends conversational and behavioral AI to autonomously complete the manual tasks involved in B2B sales, specifically designed for B2B sales reps and account executives.
Ekyam AI is an AI-powered tool that seamlessly connects different platforms like ERP, WMS, OMS, POS and E-commerce.
Newton Research is an artificial intelligence company that offers data infrastructure and analytics services.
Vultron is an AI-Native Operating System designed to help federal contractors accelerate and scale proposal development.
Playhouse MD is a healthcare retail company that offers children healthcare and personal hygiene products.
HOPPR provides medical imaging foundation models for fine-tuning to accelerate your development with higher accuracy and better performance.
Pensero.ai is an AI-powered performance review platform for engineering teams, offering real-time insights, automated analysis, and ongoing feedback.

Experiment Beauty is a skincare brand that sells products directly on its website and is native to TikTok. The brand was founded in November 2020 by Lisa Guerrera and Emmy Ketcham, both chemists, and aims to create effective products that are not stressful or boring.
Mother Science is a biotech beauty brand creating next-generation skincare solutions.
Coactive AI is a machine learning platform that unlocks analytics and insights from unstructured image and video data.

Pika is an AI video platform that allows anyone to bring their creative vision to life. The company is redesigning the video-making and editing experience with AI, providing a tool that is effortless and accessible to everyone.
Amaro was built to help companies analyze and optimize end-to-end advertising deployment using fast, intelligent automation.

Thread AI is a company aiming to make infrastructure simple for enterprises and public sector agencies seeking to get the most from AI. Its composable infrastructure platform, Lemma, enables companies to seamlessly design, implement, and manage AI-powered workflows on critical paths.
Zab’s is a St. Augustine-style hot sauce.

Tetra is a home services company that aims to make it painless to replace heating and cooling by empowering homeowners to switch from fossil fuel heating and cooling systems to high-efficiency heat pumps.
Reken is an AI & cybersecurity firm building a new type of AI platform and products to protect against generative AI-enabled fraud.
Contextual AI is building the next generation of foundation models that provide fully customizable, trustworthy, privacy-aware AI that lets you focus on the work that matters.

Harbinger is a commercial electric vehicle (EV) company on a mission to transform an industry starving for innovation. Harbinger is bringing a first-of-its-kind EV platform to market, priced for zero acquisition premium.

Character AI is a full stack neural language model (“NLM”) chatbot application that can generate human-like text responses and participate in contextual conversation. Users can create personalized “Characters” by crafting their personalities, setting specific parameters, and then publishing them to the community for others to chat with.
Whatnot is a social marketplace where you can discover some of your favorite products like sports cards, sneakers, luxury handbags and women’s thrift, Pokémon cards and more through live auctions.

Nextdata is unlocking the AI revolution with an operating system for decentralized data at scale. Its proprietary platform – Nextdata OS – is a data-mesh-native toolset for creating, sharing, discovering and using data across systems and boundaries without sacrificing governance and quality.

Together AI is the leading cloud platform for open-source and independently developed AI systems. Together AI rapidly brings the latest innovations from research to production, enabling the highest performance and efficiency.

Axios HQ is AI-powered software that helps organizations manage their essential communications. AxiosHQ powers team to plan, write, and send more effective updates to boost trust, transparency, and alignment.
Meld Studio is a desktop app empowering streamers for full creative control.
Mayk.it is a virtual music studio for next-gen music creators

Mesh’s mission is to make business identity radically simple, trusted, and portable for 100% of legitimate businesses, enabling seamless, trusted, and compliant interactions – starting with Marketplaces, Ecommerce, Home Services & Construction, and Property Management.

Bamboo Bamboo is the first modern brokerage that gives African investors and their asset managers real-time access to U.S. and global capital markets. The company’s long-term vision and largest economic opportunity is to be the investing and trading infrastructure of Africa. Bamboo aims to make investing simpler and more accessible for Africans through technology that enables fractional shares investing.

Hopscotch is a pediatric behavioral health software platform that provides both behavioral and physical care services for primary care pediatricians, behavioral health specialists, and guardians and caregivers.
Ozow is an electronic fund transaction (EFT) platform that allows consumers and businesses across South Africa to make bank-to-bank payments.

Ianacare is an enablement platform for family members that act as informal caregivers to ill loved ones. The platform enables caregivers to invite friends and family to a personal support circle, coordinates caregiving tasks and asks, and provides caregivers with a coach to navigate the challenges of caregiving

Innerwell is a mental health platform focused on enabling psychedelic-assisted therapy. The company provides patients with at-home ketamine sessions paired with talk therapy and digital content via a patient-focused application.
Narmi provides modern banking infrastructure that enables small and medium-sized banks and credit unions to offer digital products to consumers and businesses.
Salsa is a payroll technology company that offers developers tools to build payroll products for their software.

RightMove is a digitally-enabled, value-based musculoskeletal (MSK) solution for employers and health plans built on over 150 years of expertise at the #1 Orthopedic Hospital in the World, Hospital for Special Surgery (HSS). RightMove offers national on-demand virtual triage and direct access tele-physical therapy to treat over 95 conditions.

SailPlan is building modern emissions software for the transportation industry, starting with maritime. The SailPlan platform enables operators to benchmark data, optimize fuel consumption and emission outputs, and easily report this valuable information to stakeholders.

Rec Room is an online universe that enables users to play and create games with friends. The company allows users to explore millions of player-created rooms, or build something new and amazing to share with friends around the world.

Clozd is a win‐loss analysis platform for B2B companies. Customers provide Clozd with a list of their most recent deals (both wins and losses) and a point of contact; Clozd, as an unbiased third party, interviews or sends automated surveys to these contacts to collect feedback. Clozd has a team of consultants with specific domain expertise who conduct interviews and generate detailed data‐based insights which customers can view via a user‐friendly dashboard, including key decision drivers of wins and losses, win‐loss ratios, and top competitors.
Bobsled is a Data Sharing Platform that helps data providers, SaaS companies, and other providers of valuable analytics share data products into the platforms where their customers and partners work.

Prezent.AI provides a presentation productivity platform to help enterprise companies improve their corporate communications. The company’s AI-powered platform combines audience empathy, business storylines, and beautiful design to help employees create hyper-personalized presentations.

Rembrand is a programmatic platform for AI-generated product placement in digital video. Rembrand has developed a platform for inserting photo-realistic product placement dynamically into digital video in post-production.

Arthur AI enables data scientists, product owners, and business leaders to monitor and optimize machine learning (ML) model performance in production. The company provides an enterprise‐grade ML observability platform that provides real‐time performance monitoring, bias detection, and explainability. This enables ML and data science teams to detect when and where issues arise, troubleshoot the cause of the issues, and explain them to relevant stakeholders. Arthur AI is model and platform‐agnostic, providing customers with a centralized dashboard to view their ML models irrespective of the tools or platforms on which they were originally built or hosted.

Betterfly is an all-in-one benefits solution with embedded purpose-driven engagement features. The platform includes health and wellness tools, insurance and financial products, and charitable giving and social impact. Betterfly’s core platform is sold via a subscription offering as an employee benefits platform for employers to offer to all eligible employees and as a customer affinity platform to partnered insurers to offer to their insurance customers.
Arey Grey is a science-based haircare brand that aims to slow the aging process of hair.

Handoff is an end-to-end cost estimating platform for the construction industry. Handoff leverages nationwide vendor partnerships and a real-time costs database with over 1 million items to create accurate estimates. Handoff works closely with customers throughout the estimation process – from plan upload to bid submission – to ensure they win bids and save money.

Procurated is a procurement tool connecting public sector buyers with peer-reviewed suppliers. Procurated’s comprehensive vendor directory highlights top-rated suppliers in hundreds of goods and service categories, across geographic areas and socio-economic designations, helping government, education, and healthcare buyers find businesses who have done outstanding work.

Podchaser offers a comprehensive platform for podcast discovery, ratings, and reviews. It makes searching for and following podcasts easy, and it gives users the ability to rate episodes, create curated lists, and even track guest appearances.

PicassoMD is a platform that instantly connects primary care providers with trusted, local specialists to assist in triaging while the patient is still in the office. Designed by practitioners for practitioners, PicassoMD is helping reduce the $50 billion wasted every year on unnecessary ER and specialists visits.

fabric is a headless commerce platform that allows marketers and merchants to quickly turn creative commerce ideas into reality, without the need to fully rely on expensive engineering resources. An extensive and flexible API-driven approach enables brands to modernize their legacy e-commerce platforms in a matter of weeks versus months, saving time and money.

Guidewheel is a leader in cloud-powered FactoryOps, empowering factories to digitize their operations and reach sustainable peak performance. Guidewheel’s plug-and-play platform clips onto any machine on the factory floor, delivering real-time visibility that reduces lost production and improves performance.

MX is the leader in data-driven finance and the creator of the money experience category. MX helps the financial industry deliver data-driven money experiences and improve the financial lives of millions of people. With MX, banks, credit unions, and fintechs can securely connect to the world’s financial data through account aggregation, bank APIs, and transactional data enhancement.

Rocket.Chat provides the architecture for uniting all forms of communications in a single place, regardless of the user’s device or the diverse messaging services they are using. Rocket.Chat connects teams with customers, suppliers, and partners and centralizes all communications, helping teams work better and avoid missing information.

Pacaso is a marketplace that makes buying, owning, and selling a second home easy. From curating the best listings in top second home markets to offering integrated financing, upscale interior design, professional property management, and proprietary technology to make scheduling stays simple, Pacaso provides owners with all the benefits of owning a second home without the hassle.

Stable is a global hedging solution that offers a safe harbor to businesses at risk from volatile commodity prices. Stable’s advanced technology delivers price risk solutions and liquidity into commodities where no futures markets exist.
Howdy helps U.S. tech companies find and retain the best LATAM software engineering talent to power successful, diverse long-term tech teams

MyCarrier is a transportation management platform designed for carriers and companies that would like to control their shipping needs directly with their carriers. MyCarrier increases carriers’ and shippers’ process visibility to compare quotes, coordinate shipping needs, and track carrier visibility and exceptions on one platform.

Elevate is a next generation consumer directed benefits platform that makes it easier for employers and employees to view, plan, and manage pre-tax benefits from a single intuitive dashboard. All benefits can be accessed and delivered through one contactless card, claims are processed instantly, and reimbursement takes place within minutes.

FrankieOne is a cloud-native, end-to-end unified onboarding and fraud platform. The company helps banks and fintechs make better decisions using a single API and dashboard to manage Know Your Customer (KYC), Anti-Money Laundering (AML), and fraud.

Instil is a donor management platform that gives nonprofits modern technology, data visualizations, and insights to maximize their impact. Instil helps nonprofits increase donor support, drive fundraising, and run seamless campaigns with an intuitive, insight-driven experience, tailored to specific goals.

Ocient is a data analytics solutions company serving companies struggling with massive datasets that are measured in tens of terabytes, petabytes, or exabytes — with trillions or quadrillions of rows. Ocient has rethought the entire architecture of data analysis systems based upon modern high-performance, low-cost hardware in a massively parallel architecture with speed at scale as its focus.

JOKR is a global platform for grocery and retail delivery at a hyper-local scale. JOKR makes the shopping experience smarter, faster and more enjoyable, all while returning an extremely valuable asset back to the consumer: their time. JOKR delivers orders within 15 minutes of purchase and offers a smooth, frictionless and nearly instant experience.

PebblePost is the leading digital-to-direct mail marketing platform and the inventor of Programmatic Direct Mail®, which helps brands convert more shoppers into buyers using advanced targeting, algorithmic optimization, attribution, and quantitative analysis.

Breef is an agency marketplace and payments platform. As a modern outsourcing solution, the platform connects influential brands with leading agencies for all digital and creative needs. Through the Breef Platform, companies can manage everything from project planning and pitches to contracts and payments.

Addi is a financial technology company enabling digital commerce in Latin America. The company helps people buy what they want, when they want, easily, quickly, and transparently. Its initial Buy Now, Pay Later offering allows customers to make purchases in minutes with no additional costs, paperwork, or complications.

Amplify is a comprehensive life insurance platform that helps customize policies based on interests, budgets, and individual situations. Amplify offers term, permanent, and cash value life insurance and provides quotes in under five minutes.

AmplifAI leverages the power of AI to drive improved business performance while delivering greater employee and customer satisfaction and retention. AmplifAI drives digital transformation by turning call center data into insights, to auto-generate performance-relevant actions, and to distribute those personalized actions to employees and leaders.

Gorgias is a customer service platform that helps online merchants respond more effectively to customer inquiries by centralizing interactions and information, automating responses to recurring questions, and making support agents more efficient. By focusing on automation, sector-specific attention, and integration, Gorgias helps its customers tackle their customer service requests with maximum efficiency.

Openpath is a leader in mobile access control solutions. Openpath allows anyone to use their mobile phone to open an authorized door with the wave of a hand, without needing the phone or app open. Openpath’s patented Triple Unlock technology delivers 99.9% reliability for a secure, frictionless, and fast entry experience. Openpath was acquired by Motorola Solutions in 2021.

Bumble is a dating app and a movement. Bumble encourages integrity, kindness, equality, confidence, and respect during all stages of any relationship — whether online or offline. When members of the opposite sex match on Bumble, women are required to make the first move, shifting old-fashioned power dynamics and encouraging equality from the start. Bumble (NASDAQ “BMBL”) conducted its IPO in 2021.

Trullion is a financial automation platform that takes unstructured data such as PDFs and translates them into real-time financial images, including lease accounting and revenue recognition. The company creates real-time visibility into company financials by digitizing a previously manual and costly process.
Alium is a competitive intelligence platform helping go-to-market leaders of technology companies win more deals, retain more customers, and ultimately own their market.

Citizen is a personal safety network that empowers users to protect themselves and the people and places they care about. Citizen offers an app-based, localized safety network providing users with real-time information on local crimes, disease outbreak, natural disasters, air quality, and other safety-related content.

Velocity empowers developers to streamline and accelerate product delivery with the full autonomy to spin up fully isolated production-like environments on-demand, in the same easy way they are creating new Git branches.

Mapped is an AI-powered independent data layer for commercial and industrial spaces that helps property owners, facility operators, and solution providers to rapidly access real-time data from building systems, sensors, devices, and vendor APIs by automating the data discovery, extraction, and normalization process.
Crafty provides a unified ordering and reporting platform to help businesses manage their pantry, catering, cafes, and supplies for their in-office and remote employees.

Leena AI is an enterprise conversational AI that enhances employee experience via HR helpdesk automation and employee engagement software. Leena AI speaks multiple languages and gives a personalized experience to diverse workforces across the globe. The Leena AI platform offers real-time insights about helpdesk usability and employee engagement.

Craft is an enterprise intelligence company helping organizations make data-informed business decisions by delivering comprehensive, validated, and always up-to-date commercial data, analytics, and actionable insights. Craft works globally with government agencies and Fortune 500 companies in aerospace & defense, banking, pharmaceutical, and retail.

Archer is an Urban Air Mobility (“UAM”) company and developer of all-electric vertical take-off and landing (“eVTOL”) aircraft. Archer is developing the world’s first commercially viable all-electric UAM platform that will move people throughout the world’s cities in a fast, safe, sustainable, and cost-effective manner. The aircraft is expected to be capable of traveling distances of up to 60 miles at 150 mph and will transform how people approach everyday life, work, and adventure. Archer (NYSE “ACHR”) completed its public listing in 2021.

Cometeer is a coffee company that makes hyper-flavorful coffee with top-tier beans from the world’s best roasters. The coffee is ground and brewed with incredible precision to be as delicious as possible and then flash-frozen at peak flavor, and ready to be melted by coffee lovers. Because Cometeer’s capsules do not contain grounds, they are fully recyclable.

Ergatta is a connected rowing machine company that gamifies the rowing experience by tracking personal goals and fostering competition against other members of the Ergatta community. Ergatta believes working out should feel like playing a sport, not taking a class. Its machines are designed to fit in the home, aesthetically and physically.
Iru (formerly Kandji) is an AI-powered platform that unites identity & access, cross-platform endpoint security & management, and compliance automation.

Hamsa is a global real-time payments platform with a vision to disrupt the cross-border B2B e-commerce payments market. Built by the team behind AliExpress and AliPay global, HamsaPay is taking the very best of the existing financial system, and combining it with real time rails and blockchain technology.

SISU is a doctor-led clinic focused only on aesthetics. Through a network of digital-first clinics, SISU is making the world’s most advanced prevention and rejuvenation technologies accessible to a wider audience with a transparent feature-based pricing structure.

SmartHop is a total dispatch solution that enables businesses to truck smarter not harder. SmartHop uses artificial intelligence to deliver smart load recommendations, full-service back-office support, performance tracking, and digital bookings at guaranteed above-market rates for small trucking companies.

Zumper is a marketplace that provides an end-to-end rental experience for both consumers and landlords. The company streamlines the rental search and move-in process and provides landlords with the tools to select, onboard, and service tenants. Zumper provides a wider selection of inventory options relative to its peers, ranging from large multi-unit apartments to single-family homes.

RoadRunner Recycling is an innovative technology platform built for commercial recycling that provides custom recycling and waste solutions engineered to improve waste stream management. The company leverages proprietary technology to boost cost savings, improve recycling rates, and deliver unparalleled customer experiences.

Avaline Wine is a clean wine company co-founded by actress and wellness advocate Cameron Diaz and serial entrepreneur Katherine Power. All of Avaline’s products are free of unnecessary additives and include transparent ingredient lists. Avaline Wine is sold directly to consumers and through mass retail at affordable prices.

Reflexivity (formerly Toggle) is an intelligent investment dashboard empowering both institutional and retail investors with curated insights on individual securities and their broader portfolio. Like a GPS for investing, the platform helps investors navigate a wide array of markets with instant insights tailored to their investing style.

Segment is a customer data platform that democratizes access to reliable data for all teams and offers a complete toolkit to standardize data collection, unify user records, and route customer data into any system where it is needed. More than 20,000 companies like Intuit, FOX, Instacart, and Levi’s use Segment to make real-time decisions, accelerate growth, and deliver compelling user experiences. Segment was acquired by Twilio in 2020.

Cardless is a credit card company focused on helping today’s most exciting brands launch credit card products for their superfans. Cardless helps brands issue and manage customized loyalty credit card programs through which they can reward customers with amazing experiences, merchandise, and exclusive offers, alongside the features consumers would expect from any other card offer.

Podsights allows advertisers and podcasters a better way to measure campaign performance. From campaign planning to performance measurement, Podsights makes tools that enable brands to leverage the podcasting medium. Podsights was acquired by Spotify in 2022.

Loyal Guru is a customer data platform that makes it easy for retailers to collect customer data and activate it through loyalty programs and personalized offers. Loyal Guru collects and unifies customer data, uses analytics to understand customer behavior, and enables customers to build an effective loyalty program specific to their industry.

Mercato is an e-commerce and order management solution for independent grocers. The company’s online marketplace lets consumers order same-day or scheduled delivery of high-quality and specialty foods. Mercato offers both a la carte delivery for a fee as well as its “Mercato Green” subscription with unlimited free delivery.

Petabyte is an end-to-end pet health platform with two products: a veterinary SaaS platform called Rhapsody and a consumer membership offering called Boop. Rhapsody is cloud-based software that manages scheduling, drug inventory, and billing for veterinary practices. Boop is the companion mobile-application for consumer pet services and products.

Octave is a national behavioral health practice supporting all aspects of emotional well-being. The company offers personalized plans using the right combination of therapy and psychiatry, coaching and classes to best fit clients’ lives in a safe space that provides confidence and calm. Grounded in science, the Octave community enables clients to experience profound change that is just as measurable as it is meaningful.

Hidden Road is a leading global credit network for institutions, enabling seamless credit through quantitatively-driven technology. The company’s products include prime brokerage, clearing, and financing across FX, digital assets, and derivatives.

Unbabel is an AI-powered, human-refined translation platform that enables multilingual customer service at scale. It transforms customer contact centers from a cost to profit center, providing automated translation, quality estimation, human expertise, and CRM integrations.

Rapid Robotics is the creator of the first affordable robotic machine operator designed for simple machine tasks. Requiring absolutely no programming, systems integration, specialized hardware or robotics skills, the Rapid Machine Operator enables manufacturers to easily deploy a pre-trained robot in hours, moving it between tasks as needed and seeing ROI in months.

MERIT is a minimalist, clean, luxury beauty brand that creates products that are safe for the body, skin, and planet. Offering high-performing products that create a polished look in minutes, MERIT embodies founder Katherine Power’s philosophy of five-minute makeup, placing value on minimalism to bring more, with less.

Thankful is an AI platform for customer service solutions that understands what customers want and delivers the answers they need, establishing lasting relationships through better service. The Thankful platform consists of products that enhance the customer service processes through four key elements: understanding, resolution, personalization, and intelligence. Thankful was acquired by Gladly in 2023.

Goop is a modern lifestyle company that offers contextual commerce, special real-life experiences, conversation-inspiring content, and unique products. Goop operates from a place of curiosity and non judgment and starts hard conversations, cracks open taboos, and looks for connection and resonance.

Hum Capital is an intelligent credit market that helps growth companies raise capital without dilution using cutting edge financial analytics. Hum Capital believes that all companies should be empowered to see their businesses as clearly as seasoned investors do and that with the right tools, accessing institutional capital can become as predictable and efficient as buying a product on Amazon.

Haystack is a platform that connects a company’s distributed employees, disparate systems, and top-down communications channels to a centralized hub. It is the modern employee intranet that helps make big companies feel smaller by streamlining internal communications and forging employee connections.

Invisible is a business process automation platform that automates repetitive digital work by managing and outsourcing recurring tasks to human agents. Clients from Fortune 500 companies to startups use Invisible to run their big and small business processes more efficiently.

Landing is a network of professionally-designed, fully-furnished apartments with flexible lease terms. Landing offers its members an industry-first all-inclusive, flexible living experience. Members have access to Landing’s studios, one, and two-bedroom apartments with an on-call concierge service and a host of additional amenities.

Lightricks is the creator of leading photo and video creativity apps, including Facetune2, Videoleap, and Artleap. The company brings a unique blend of cutting-edge academic research, technology, and design to every product experience it creates. Lightricks’ suite of apps has over 400 million downloads worldwide and has won numerous prestigious awards.
Bluex Trade is all-in-one platform that amplifies cash flow for buyers and sellers.

Anycart is the world’s first online grocery shopping engine connecting shoppers to local stores to quickly and easily find the groceries they need. Anycart makes shopping and meal planning easy and affordable for everyone with free delivery, no required memberships, no price mark-ups, real-time store inventory, and 1000+ shoppable recipes. Anycart was acquired by Weee! in 2022.

Palmetto is the leading clean technology software and fulfillment platform company. Palmetto is focused on building and deploying simplified software systems that help consumers understand their energy spend. The company continues to innovate proprietary products to reduce costs and drive widespread distribution of simple energy management solutions.

Semrush is a leading online visibility management SaaS platform that enables businesses globally to run search engine optimization, pay-per-click, content, social media, and competitive research campaigns and get measurable results from online marketing. Semrush offers insights and solutions for companies to build, manage, and measure campaigns across various marketing channels. Semrush (NYSE “SEMR” ) had its IPO in 2021.

Bird is a transportation company guided by a shared vision: to make cities more livable through safe, sustainable electric mobility. From its first e-scooter ride in 2017 to the thousands of rides taking place every day, Bird’s award-winning custom vehicles have helped riders complete hundreds of millions of carbon-free trips in more than 150 cities around the world. Bird (NYSE “BRDS”) completed its public listing in 2021.

Wondery is a leading podcast publisher known for character-driven, binge-worthy stories including “Dying for Sex,” “Dr. Death,” “The Shrink Next Door,” “Blood Ties,” and “Business Wars.” Wondery has gained critical acclaim and commercial success for its immersive approach to sonic, emotionally immersive storytelling, which helps listeners to “feel the story.” Wondery was acquired by Amazon in 2021.
Chartable’s podcast analytics and attribution tools help publishers grow, and help brands & agencies understand their spend. Chartable was acquired by Spotify in 2022.

Versed is a clean drugstore skincare brand that formulates products to the highest clean standards, banning over 1,300 toxins to ensure its products are safe for human bodies and skin. Versed is also committed to reducing waste, lightening its carbon footprint, and preserving Earth’s ecosystems.

Pie Insurance is an insurtech company that is modernizing small business insurance by automating the entire experience to provide simple, trusted, and affordable coverage. Pie’s unique combination of innovative technology, sophisticated analytics, and industry expertise enables savings of up to 30% for small business owners on AM Best A- (Excellent) rated workers’ comp insurance.

Branch is a pioneer in bundling home and car insurance online. Branch utilizes innovative technology to make bundling home and auto insurance online quicker and easier than ever before. By tapping into the power of community, Branch is on a mission to make insurance more accessible and affordable for everyone.

Fetch is a consumer loyalty and shopper rewards app. By working directly with hundreds of popular brands, Fetch gives shoppers access to savings on tens of thousands of products, whenever and wherever they are purchased.

ClosedLoop is a healthcare data science platform that makes it easy and affordable for healthcare organizations to use data science to improve quality and reduce costs. By providing off-the-shelf models for common healthcare use cases and automating many of the manual processes involved in traditional data science tasks, ClosedLoop allows data scientists to focus on the impactful problems that drive real value for organizations.

Credit Key is a B2B financial services technology company that allows merchants to offer an instant Buy Now Pay Later function that is seamlessly integrated at checkout. Credit Key’s proprietary process facilitates lightning-fast financing approval that is unique in the B2B space and proven to help merchants drive sales, revenue, and conversions.

Enboarder is an experience-driven platform that transforms employee onboarding into an ongoing, rich, and consistent experience, at scale. Enboarder makes new hires feel welcome and prepared and empowers HR teams and managers to create, deliver, and measure the impact of communications, helping to lay the foundation for a great culture and long-term employment.

Lucy is the designer, manufacturer, and seller of nicotine alternative products. Lucy’s mission is to reduce tobacco-related harm to zero by creating superior nicotine products that can deliver a satisfying experience for adult tobacco users.

Osmosis is a medical education technology company that offers an online study platform for students in the medical field. The company creates high-quality animated videos with voiceovers, question banks, collaborative study tools, and flashcards. The system uses AI to recommend videos, questions, and other resources most relevant to students based on the concepts highlighted in their curriculum. Osmosis was acquired by Elsevier in 2021.

Pryon is an AI company that delivers augmented intelligence for the enterprise. Driven by the inventors of core natural language technologies, the company is developing a platform that connects employees to digital transformation, extending their ability to find and use knowledge, drive workflows, and make better decisions from wherever they are.

Red Balloon Security is a leading cybersecurity provider and research firm that specializes in the protection of embedded devices across all industries. The company’s technology defends embedded systems with a suite of host-based firmware security solutions that provide continuous runtime protection of firmware and secure embedded systems against exploitation.

Tapcart is a mobile commerce SaaS platform that integrates directly with Shopify, enabling brands to quickly and easily build native mobile apps for their e-commerce stores. The company is trusted by thousands of Shopify brands including Fashion Nova, Chubbies, Urban Planet, and more.

Asana Rebel is a yoga-inspired health and fitness app for anyone who wants to get in shape, have more energy, sleep better, and increase their productivity. The subscription app is available in six languages, has been featured multiple times by Apple and Google, and is rated as one of the top health and fitness apps.

NeueHealth is an integrated healthcare platform that creates a personalized and affordable consumer experience by improving access to healthcare and enabling stronger relationships between patients and their providers. NeueHealth provides consumers access to personalized care teams tailored to their individual needs and gives providers the tools they need to optimize their practices and deliver valued-based care to the patients they serve. NeauHealth (NYSE “BHG”) conducted its IPO in 2021.

Comparably is a workplace culture and compensation monitoring site that provides the most comprehensive and accurate representation of what it’s like to work at companies. Employees can anonymously rate their employers in multiple workplace culture categories, providing the public a transparent and in-depth look at the experiences different segments of workers have based on gender, ethnicity, age, department, tenure, location, education, and company size. Comparably was acquired by ZoomInfo in 2022.

Billie provides women with quality shaving supplies and premium body care products designed to make a daily routine a little more delightful and more affordable. Billie was acquired by Edgewell Personal Care Company in 2021.

Kheiron Medical Technologies is an applied science company focused on supporting cancer diagnostics with machine learning. Kheiron Medical’s first product Mia™ has been developed to improve the outcomes for the more than two million women diagnosed globally every year with breast cancer.

Embrace is the only observability and data platform built exclusively for mobile. With actionable data and insights derived from every single user experience, companies can deliver better mobile experiences and make optimal business decisions by understanding the true drivers of retention and revenue.

Public.com is an investing platform that lets customers build a portfolio across any fractional asset class. On Public, members can build their portfolio with any fractional asset – including stocks; ETFs, crypto & NFTs, and art collectibles – all in one place. This ownership unlocks an experience that’s contextual to one’s portfolio. With social audio programming around breaking news and insights from experts, conversations with company leaders on its Town Hall Q&A, and insights and analysis from a community of millions of other investors, creators and analysts, Public is redefining a modern portfolio and sophisticated investing experience.

Imperative Execution is a financial technology company that builds trading venues that optimize execution performance. It is a pioneer in using AI in market design and order matching. Founded by former traders, Imperative Execution is the parent company of Intelligent Cross, which operates the IntelligentCross ATS, the industry’s first smart venue to use AI in order matching to achieve high execution performance.

ZenBusiness is an online platform for business owners who want a solution to the challenges of starting, running, and growing a business. ZenBusiness uses technology and automation to provide fast and low-cost services, expert support, and a personalized dashboard that puts everything a business owner needs right at their fingertips.

Happiest Baby is a lifestyle brand dedicated to helping parents succeed in rearing and raising happy and healthy children. The company’s first product, the SNOO, uses advanced robotic technology to imitate the rhythmic sensations babies love in the womb. The SNOO rocks all night and “hears” when the baby cries, responding with just enough motion and sound to calm most crying in under a minute.

Emerge is a digital freight marketplace connecting shippers and carriers. The platform provides access to direct capacity and live market conditions helping shippers make the strongest, most beneficial decisions when procuring domestic trucking. Emerge provides access to benchmarked rates and thousands of trusted partners to maximize cost savings.

Boulder Care is a full-service digital clinic for patients struggling with substance abuse disorders. The company provides medication, resources, and support to help participants succeed on their own terms, wherever they are in their journey. Boulder Care’s program is designed by addiction medicine specialists and people with lived experiences of recovery.

Overtime is the leading brand for the next generation of sports fans. As both a publisher and an influencer, Overtime has built an inclusive world of sports by giving a platform to its community to be seen and heard. Overtime Elite (OTE) is a transformative new sports league that offers the world’s most talented young basketball players a better pathway to becoming professional athletes and engage and inspire a new generation of fans.

Thirty Madison is a healthcare company for people living with chronic conditions. Thirty Madison’s unique care model delivers accessible, affordable care, and superior outcomes for hundreds of thousands of patients. This specialized care model is powered by the company’s proprietary platform: the technology, services, and physical infrastructure needed to provide high-quality care to an increasing number of patients.

YieldStreet is an investment marketplace that is changing the way wealth is created by providing access to asset-based investments historically unavailable to most investors. YieldStreet allows accredited investors to participate in investment opportunities with low stock market correlation across litigation finance, real estate, and other alternative asset classes.

Seed Health is a microbial sciences company pioneering applications of bacteria to impact human and environmental health. In collaboration with leading academic partners, Seed Health accelerates breakthrough science into live biotherapeutics and innovations for consumer health. The current pipeline includes interventions for infectious disease, allergy, and inflammatory conditions.

AZA is a provider of currency trading solutions that accelerate global access to frontier markets. By leveraging cutting-edge technology, AZA is able to significantly lower the cost and increase the speed of business payments to and from frontier markets. Licensed by the UK’s Financial Conduct Authority and the Bank of Spain, AZA is a market-maker in every major African currency.

Frame AI is an early warning and continuous monitoring system that makes the customer voice an effective operational tool to inform data-driven customer experience priorities. By consolidating and enriching data across helpdesk, call center, CRM, and other channels, the company makes emerging themes that drive customer relationships and operational costs immediately actionable.

Axios is a digital media company delivering trustworthy breaking news and invaluable insights to help readers and viewers get smarter, faster across the topics reshaping our lives in politics, tech, business, media, science, and the world. Axios was created around a simple proposition: deliver the cleanest, smartest, most efficient, and trustworthy experience for readers and advertisers alike.

Shipt is a community of Shipt Shoppers and an app that provides personal shopping and delivery. Shipt offers access to a variety of stores and product categories including fresh foods, household essentials, wellness products, office and pet supplies. Shipt was acquired by Target in 2017.

Data Plus Math is a media measurement company that works with brands, agencies, cable operators, streaming TV services, and networks to tie cross-screen ad exposure with real-world outcomes. Data Plus Math was acquired by LiveRamp in 2019.

Voicea is the creator of a market-leading real-time solution that provides meeting transcription, voice search, and meeting highlights/action items, with robust data privacy. It helps teams have more productive and actionable meetings by turning talk into action. Voicea was acquired by Cisco in 2019.

Anine Bing is a next-generation fashion brand inspired by Scandinavian simplicity and American energy and focused on everyday wardrobe essentials and investment pieces for modern women seeking a timeless yet rebellious approach to style. Anine Bing designs are thoughtfully sourced from the highest quality fabrications and materials, including leather, silk, linen, cashmere, and 14k gold.

Nom Nom serves fresh, whole ingredient pet foods, developed by on-staff Board Certified Veterinary Nutritionists, to dogs and cats across the country. With recipes backed by science, each meal contains fresh and visible ingredients that are packed with natural vitamins and minerals. Nom Nom was acquired by Mars Petcare in 2021.

HealthVerity is a technology platform that serves as the foundation for the rapid creation, exchange, and management of healthcare and consumer data in a fully-interoperable, privacy-protecting manner. Advantaged by highly sophisticated identity resolution and matching capabilities, HealthVerity is on a mission to increase transparency, forge interoperability, and activate deeper insights.

HopSkipDrive is a safe, dependable youth transportation platform that connects schools, districts, government agencies, and families with professional, experienced CareDrivers offering their transportation services. The advanced technology platform and industry-leading operational expertise provide unparalleled flexibility, visibility, and safety.

Expel is a security operations center (SOC)-as-a-service provider committed to making security as accessible as the internet. Its SOC-as-a-service capability offers 24/7 security monitoring and response for cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments. Expel connects to customer tech remotely through APIs, not agents, so its SOC can start monitoring a customer’s environment in a matter of hours.

Flutterwave is a payments technology company that helps businesses all over the world expand their operations in Africa and other emerging markets through a platform that enables cross-border transactions via one API. The company’s key advantage is international payment processing in 150 currencies and multiple payment modes, including local and international cards, mobile wallets, bank transfers, and Barter by Flutterwave.

Immuta is a leader in cloud data access control, empowering data engineering and operations teams to automate data governance, security, access control, and privacy protection. Data-driven organizations rely on Immuta to speed time to data, safely share more data with more users, and mitigate the risk of data leaks and breaches.

Partnerize is a leading provider of partnership automation solutions for global brands. The company’s Partnerize Partnership Automation Platform delivers data-driven intelligence and management tools that are essential for materially improving ROI. The Partnerize platform has won more than two dozen awards including Best Technology at the International Performance Marketing Awards.

Raisin GmbH is a global fintech firm that provides an open banking infrastructure for the global $50+ trillion deposit market that benefits banks and savers alike. Savers receive more product choice and decision power, customer-facing institutions like banks benefit from best-in-class savings marketplace solutions for their own customers, and deposit-taking banks receive flexible, cost-effective access to diversified deposit funding. Raisin operates its own B2C platforms across Europe and the U.K. under the Raisin, WeltSparen, Savedo, and ZINSPILOT brands, and in the U.S. under the SaveBetter brand.

Thrive Global is a leading behavior change tech company helping individuals, corporations, and communities improve their wellbeing and performance through a behavior change platform, storytelling, and corporate services. Thrive was founded by Arianna Huffington with the mission of changing the way humans work and live by ending the collective delusion that burnout is the price to pay for success.

Albert is an instructional platform that empowers teachers to unlock the potential in all learners. Albert leverages a library of practice items across math, ELA, science, and social studies and offers instant feedback and detailed explanations based on a user’s answers. Teachers can track student progress and determine areas to focus on and improve instruction.

Octiv is a sales productivity platform designed to create efficiencies in process workflows for managing documents and assets like sales presentations, quotes, proposals and contracts. The company integrates data from CRM, CPQ, ERP, and other systems to streamline workflows, save time, and accelerate sales opportunities. Octiv was acquired by Conga in 2018.

Wonderbly is an award winning publishing company that plays at the intersection of storytelling and technology. The company is on a mission to inspire boundless self-belief in children through clever and sophisticated personalization. Wonderbly is building a new class of publishing that brings millions of people into high quality products to empower them to build connections with each other. Wonderbly was acquired by Graphite Capital in 2021.

Inventables is a 3D carving company offering intuitive software, an easy-to-use carving machine, and unique carving materials. Easel and Easel Pro, its design platforms, are the most accessible and user-friendly design software on the market. Paired with affordable 3D carving machines, makers of all abilities can produce their first project in minutes.

Icertis is a contract intelligence company. The AI-powered, analyst-validated Icertis Contract Intelligence (ICI) platform turns contracts from static documents into strategic advantage by structuring and connecting the critical contract information that defines how an organization runs.

Flashpoint is the trusted leader in actionable threat intelligence for organizations that demand coverage of threatening activity on the internet. From bolstering cyber and physical security to detecting fraud and insider threats, Flashpoint partners with customers across private and public sectors to help them rapidly identify threats and mitigate their most critical security risks. Flashpoint was acquired by Audax Private Equity in 2021.

Vettery is a two-sided talent marketplace that aims to displace traditional executive recruiters. Each week Vettery curates a unique list of candidates, and hiring companies browse applicant profiles and request interviews directly through the platform. Vettery was acquired by Adecco Group in 2018.

MapAnything is the leading provider of geo-enabled field productivity solutions for field sales and services organizations. MapAnything enables customers to design optimal territories, create optimal schedules, and map optimal routes so field reps can service more accounts in less time. MapAnything was acquired by Salesforce in 2019.

Blinkist is a mobile learning company that transforms insights from some of the world’s best nonfiction books into powerful, mobile summaries. Blinkist delivers the main concepts of a book or topic in 15 minutes. Blinkist was acquired by Go1 in 2023.

Cotopaxi is an outdoor gear brand and Benefit Corporation with a social mission. With storefronts and an ecommerce platform, Cotopaxi designs, manufactures, and sells packs, water bottles, apparel, and gear, raising awareness and funds for various humanitarian causes through the Cotopaxi Foundation. Greycroft’s interest sold to Bain Capital in 2021.

Amperity is a comprehensive enterprise customer data platform that provides intelligent capabilities across data management and unification, analytics and insights, and activation. Amperity helps brands get to know their customers, make strategic decisions, and take the right course of action to grow their businesses.

Firstleaf is a customer-centric winery building the next generation of premium wine brands. Collaborating with famed winemakers and sourcing from vineyards around the globe, the company’s wines have won hundreds of awards, including multiple 95+ point scores, Best in Show, and Winery of the Year. Firstleaf sells through retail, restaurants, and direct-to-consumer, including via its wine club.

Acorns is a leading micro-investing app. Its easy-to-use, mobile-first technology makes it simple for anyone to set aside and invest spare money. Acorns allows customers to automatically invest in a low-cost, diversified portfolio of exchange-traded funds offered by some of the world’s top asset managers, including Vanguard and Blackrock.

Thrive Market is an online, membership-based market that delivers the highest quality, healthy and sustainable products at member-only prices, while matching every paid membership with a free one for someone in need. Thrive Market carries a curation of organic and non-GMO products and offers 100+ filters and values, allowing members to shop by diet and lifestyle.

Static Media is a modern media company that operates a content portal, destination sites, and a recommendation platform that is used by thousands of media companies. Static Media is the only content recommendation company focused on sending incremental traffic and unique visitors to its partners at scale. Its largest partners get hundreds of thousands of unique visitors every day from Static Media.

Dots is a mobile casual game studio that creates games with unique and thoughtful designs. The studio has created three mobile hits, Dots, Two Dots and Dots & Co., with Two Dots selected as an Editor’s Choice in both the Google Play Store and Apple App Store. Dots was acquired by Take Two Interactive Software in 2020.

Yeahka is a Chinese mobile payment service provider that offers mobile point of sale card payments, SMB lending, and other value‐add software to small and mid‐sized merchants in China. With extensive experience in the payments industry, Yeahka has made significant progress in key technologies in mobile payment, such as QR code payment technology, NFC payment technology, and independently developed JCVM technology. Yeahka (HKSE “9923.HK”) had its IPO in 2020.

Plated is a meal kit subscription service aimed at helping people eat better and healthier by delivering gourmet recipes and ingredients to their homes. The company sends meal-sized proportions of fresh ingredients that are pre-assembled and chef-designed to its customers. Plated was acquired by Albertsons in 2017.

Cuyana is a digital-first fashion brand that believes in fewer, better things. Cuyana creates apparel and accessories, designed with a classic, modern aesthetic, sourced from the world’s highest quality materials, and crafted to last a lifetime. By selling directly to customers, Cuyana is able to offer high-quality, timeless pieces at attainable prices.

Bread is a technology-driven payments company transforming the way consumers shop. Bread powers seamless payment experiences and APIs that allow retailers and partners to offer shoppers more ways to pay over time. Bread was acquired by Alliance Data Systems in 2020.

Azimo is the leading mobile remittance provider making it easier to send money to more than 200 countries and territories worldwide. Azimo’s mission is to use technology to democratize financial services, making them affordable and available to all. With almost a million downloads and 30,000+ 5-star reviews across the App Store, Google Play and Trustpilot, Azimo provides faster, safer money transfers for everyone. Azimo was acquired by Papaya Global in 2022.

Button is a mobile commerce technology company that is powering a commerce-driven internet. As the leading mobile commerce enablement platform, Button powers mobile growth for the world’s largest brands and publishers, while offering consumers more seamless, enjoyable experiences. With each action taken, brands make sales, publishers earn revenue, and consumers get exactly what they want at the tap of a button.

Earnest Analytics is the largest provider of data analytics products providing restaurants, retailers, e-commerce companies, and investment clients with critical knowledge on consumer spending habits to power data-driven business decisions. With accurate and near real-time data on sales, orders, and other purchasing trends, Earnest Analytics enables companies to deeply understand customer habits.

ELOQUII is an e-commerce destination transforming the way women sizes 14+ dress and participate in fashion. ELOQUII offers trend-driven style at accessible price points. The company debuts new and exciting trend-leading collections each month in merchandise categories including apparel, swim, wide width footwear, and accessories. ELOQUII was acquired by Walmart in 2018.

Farfetch is the leading global platform for the luxury fashion industry. The Farfetch Marketplace connects customers in over 190 countries and territories with items from more than 50 countries and over 1,300 of the world’s best brands, boutiques, and department stores, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a single platform. Farfetch (NYSE “FTCH”) conducted its IPO in 2018.

Skimlinks is a commerce content monetization platform. Its technology automatically monetizes product links in commerce-related content to earn publishers a share of sales they drive. Skimlinks’ platform is a one-stop solution providing the technology and the data to start and scale content commerce strategies across desktop and mobile. Skimlinks was acquired by Connexity in 2020.

Vidible is a video management and exchange technology platform that enables buyers and sellers of digital media to manage and monetize video content across all devices. Vidible was acquired by AOL in 2014.

Nativo is a technology platform for brand content advertising that delivers integrated ad formats and greater revenue opportunities for publishers and commerce companies, enabling brand storytelling at scale for advertisers and an improved advertising experience for consumers.

Boxed is an online and mobile wholesale retailer that gives consumers direct-to-their-door access to all of their favorite warehouse club products. Boxed brings convenience and savings to on-the-go consumers who don’t have the time, means, or patience to shop at a brick-and-mortar big box club, all with no membership fees. Boxed (NYSE “BOXD”) completed its public listing in 2021.

When I Work is a workforce management business that provides hourly workplaces with an integrated scheduling, time tracking, and team messaging solution that enhances the employee experience and drives better business outcomes. The company’s employee management solution ensures reliable shift coverage, engaged employees, and faster decisions that help hourly teams work better together. Greycroft’s interest sold to Bain Capital in 2021.

Group Nine is the #1 video publisher on mobile in the U.S., and its brands are built for the platforms where young people spend the majority of their time. Group Nine reaches over 80% of Americans in their 20s every month who are engaging with category-defining brands – NowThis, The Dodo, POPSUGAR, Thrillist, and Seeker. Group Nine Media was acquired by Vox media in 2022.

Braintree is a global payments partner that provides innovative payments technology, scalable solutions, and white-glove support to help people build businesses, accept payments, and enable commerce. Merchants in more than 45 countries and regions worldwide can accept, split, and enable payments in more than 130 currencies using Braintree. Braintree was acquired by Paypal in 2013.

Clique Brands is a global media and consumer brands company that combines the power of data science with an expert editorial team to create content and products that millennial women and Gen Z girls crave. Clique Brands includes the international fashion company Who What Wear, the clean beauty company Versed, and the popular podcast Second Life. Clique was acquired by Future plc in 2022.

Fortumo is a global platform for payments inside mobile apps. Users can make one-click payments using Fortumo without the need for a credit card – payments are charged to their mobile operator bill instead. Fortumo was acquired by Boku in 2020.

Data.ai combines consumer and market data with artificial intelligence (AI) to provide insights for the digital economy. Their platform includes a proprietary mobile performance score (MPS) that helps brands improve their apps and create better digital experiences.

WorkFusion is a top provider of industry-specialized intelligent automation solutions that are powered by learning bots, proprietary artificial intelligence technology and advanced analytics, working together to automate a wide range of business operations, and specializing in the needs of banking, insurance and healthcare companies. Greycroft’s interest sold to Georgian in 2021.

JW Player is the world’s largest network-independent platform for video delivery and intelligence. Media companies including Fox, VICE, Insider, and Univision, in addition to hundreds of thousands of creators of all types and sizes, rely on JW Player to deliver and monetize their content across all devices.

NuORDER is a B2B e-commerce software solution that helps brands and retailers streamline their business operations. NuORDER provides brands and retailers a central hub to browse products and catalogs, access real-time inventory data, and place orders online or from a mobile app. NuORDER was acquired by Lightspeed in 2021.

BetterCloud is a leading SaaS management platform that enables IT professionals to discover, manage, and secure their cloud applications. BetterCloud helps organizations get the transformative value and benefits of adopting SaaS applications, while ensuring IT has complete control over their environment and can serve as an enabler for the business. BetterCloud was acquired by Vista Equity Partners in 2022.

The RealReal is an online consignment business focused on curating and authenticating a full range of luxury products such as clothing, shoes, accessories, and jewelry. The company receives items from the closets of the world’s most fashionable men and women and gives its members insider access to the world’s best previously owned luxury, such as Louis Vuitton and Chanel at up to 90% off of retail price. TheRealReal (NASDAQ “REAL”) had its IPO in 2019.

BaubleBar is a fashion jewelry brand changing how women shop for fashion jewelry. BaubleBar offers on-trend styles contextualized through strong editorial references and uses real-time data to merchandise and design based on current market dynamics and consumer taste preferences.

Scopely is a global interactive entertainment and mobile games company, home to many top-grossing, award-winning franchises including Scrabble® GO, MARVEL Strike Force, Star Trek™ Fleet Command, Looney Tunes™ World of Mayhem, WWE Champions, The Walking Dead: Road To Survival™, YAHTZEE® With Buddies and Wheel of Fortune®: Free Play, among others. Scopely creates immersive games that empower a directed-by-consumer experience. Scopely was acquired by Savvy Games Group in 2023.

Venmo is an app for fast, safe, social payments between friends. Venmo allows customers to send and receive money from their friends and connect with brands and businesses. Venmo was acquired by Braintree in 2012 which was acquired by PayPal in 2013.

Trunk Club is a personalized styling service for men and women, offering both virtual and in-person shopping experiences. Customers can visit Trunk Club’s retail Clubhouses for an in-person styling session or choose a virtual styling option, where a personal stylist sends a curated trunk of clothing based on the customer’s style, fit, and lifestyle preferences. Trunk Club was acquired by Nordstrom in 2014.

Mountain Digital (formerly SteelHouse) builds advertising software for brands to drive measurable conversions, revenue, site visits and more through the power of television. MNTN Performance TV is the world’s first and only Connected TV advertising platform optimized for direct-response marketing goals. It redefines what advertisers can do with television, giving them the power to tie performance directly to their TV campaigns.

Resonate is an AI-driven consumer data and intelligence platform. Companies use Resonate to drive better marketing strategy and execution fueled by a more comprehensive understanding of their customers and prospects that extends beyond traditional demographics, psychographics, and behavioral data to uncover why consumers choose, buy or support certain brands, products or causes. Resonate was acquired by ZMC Management in 2022.

Maker Studios is a next-generation, talent-first media company home to many of online video’s top digital stars and content. The company is the only network to offer partners development, production, promotion, distribution, sales, and marketing services. Maker Studios was acquired by Disney in 2014.

Aventri (formerly eTouches) is a data-driven, end-to-end event and meeting management solution for virtual, hybrid, and in-person events. The company’s fully integrated SaaS platform includes virtual delivery, networking, venue sourcing, registration, marketing, logistics, onsite services, attendee engagement, and data analytics. Aventri was acquired by HGGC in 2017.

Extreme Reach is an asset management solution for TV and video advertising that helps marketers and their agencies control the deployment of creative assets and how the media sources those ads to execute campaigns across the complex media landscape. The company’s platform seamlessly integrates video ad serving, linear TV distribution, OTT/CTV delivery, and talent; rights management together.

Babble is a website for a new generation of parents that offers extensive resources, such as well-written and highly relevant articles, interactive tools, and a growing community. Babble was acquired by Disney in 2011.

Buddy Media is a social marketing suite that helps brands build powerful connections globally with its scalable, secure architecture and data-driven consumer insights from initial point of contact through point of purchase. Buddy Media was acquired by Salesforce in 2012.

Vizu is an online ad technology company whose solutions allow advertisers and publishers to measure and optimize brand lift in real-time. Vizu enables its customers to move their target audience through the purchase funnel, from building awareness to creating intent and preference. Vizu was acquired by Nielsen in 2012.

Sometrics helps publishers market free-to-play online games and monetize virtual currency with a consumer destination site and the industry’s most advanced in-game payment solutions. With Sometrics in-game payment and optimization platform, game publishers gain a new revenue source that enhances existing payment methods and increases conversions among paying users. Sometrics was acquired by American Express in 2011.

WideOrbit is a digital and linear media management advertising platform that helps clients do more business by eliminating paper-chasing and data re-re-entry of traditional workflows. WideOrbit is a leader in premium broadcast technology and the largest sell-side processor of premium advertising, both digital and linear. Greycroft’s interest sold to company management in 2020.

Ceros is a cloud-based experiential content creation platform that empowers marketers and designers to create rich, interactive content without code or traditional web development. The Ceros Studio is the only platform of its kind with the ability to produce creative content experiences at scale. Ceros was acquired by Sumeru Equity Partners in 2020.

HealthPlanOne is a leading Medicare and health insurance sales and marketing organization. HealthPlanOne’s mission is to “decomplexify” Medicare for customers across the country to match each customer with the optimal plan, with a focus on the long term, to support better health and deliver peace of mind. HealthPlanOne was acquired by Peloton Equity in 2014.

The Huffington Post is an Internet newspaper founded by Arianna Huffington and Kenneth Lerer that takes a people-first approach to reporting—be it news and politics or lifestyle and entertainment. The Huffington Post was acquired by AOL in 2011.
